question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a purple ball, Claire has a yellow ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a red ball, and Gertrude has a teal ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Fred and Eve swap balls. Finally, Alice and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) purple ball
(C) yellow ball
(D) grey ball
(E) black ball
(F) red ball
(G) teal ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: brown, purple, yellow, grey, black, red, teal
1. Eve ↔ Dave: brown, purple, yellow, black, grey, red, teal
2. Alice ↔ Bob: purple, brown, yellow, black, grey, red, teal
3. Gertrude ↔ Claire: purple, brown, teal, black, grey, red, yellow
4. Alice ↔ Gertrude: yellow, brown, teal, black, grey, red, purple
5. Alice ↔ Gertrude: purple, brown, teal, black, grey, red, yellow
6. Fred ↔ Eve: purple, brown, teal, black, red, grey, yellow
7. Alice ↔ Fred: grey, brown, teal, black, red, purple, yellow
Eve has the red ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
